attempted_axis: Introduce the Xbox PDB enum OPTMENU_TYPE into options.c and respell the options_state / OPTMENU.state magic constants; then convert the TU's remaining raw-offset colour-trio reads.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.single-base-relocation-refutes-symbol-separation.20260831.v1 (authored this session on shop.c): APPLIED, and it is what stopped the second half of this pass -- see residual. claim.law.walked-base-symbol-identity and claim.law.local-alias-vs-direct-global-spelling-diverges: APPLIED, same reasoning, the colour-trio base is a symbol-identity question not a formatting one. Enum adoption itself engages no codegen law: enum constants are ints in C89 and cannot change the emitted bytes, which the gate then confirmed; the risk in this half of the pass was purely semantic misnaming, so the screen that mattered was against the in-tree behavioural annotations rather than against the law corpus. claim.law.offsetof-hazard-is-per-base-not-per-function: screened, not reached, no offsetof form was introduced in options.c.
attributes.residual: THE ENUM IS DELIBERATELY TRUNCATED AT 2 AND MUST NOT BE COMPLETED FROM THE PDB. The Xbox body continues to LAST=27, but the GC numbering demonstrably diverges past 2, and the conflict is visible in the TU's own pre-existing behavioural annotations: GC `case 4` is the quit-confirm menu where Xbox has GAME=4, and GC `case 10` is a radio menu driven by optglobals.style where Xbox has DIFFICULTY=10. Some arms do agree -- GC `case 8` is the audio-slider menu against Xbox AUDIO=8, and 19/20 line up with the QUITGAME/QUITLEVEL pair -- so the two enums are related but not identical, which is the worst case for blind adoption: it would import names that are wrong for some arms and right for others with nothing to distinguish them. The three adopted members each carry independent GC corroboration that predates this pass (options_state's own comment reads 0=closed and 1=finishing; the dispatch arm was already annotated `case 2: /* title menu */`, and TitleMenu/TitleMenuEnd are the functions that test it). To resolve 3..27 someone must read the state field out of each optmenu_* OPTMENU initializer in .data across 0x8011DEBC..0x8011FA38 and map ids to menus directly; the full Xbox body is recorded verbatim in the source comment so that work needs no second PDB trip. SECOND HALF NOT ATTEMPTED, refuted on the disasm without spending a build: the remaining raw sites read a colour trio at `data + 216/220/224` and `base + 228/232/236` where data is lbl_8011DD20, whose recorded size is 0x90 = 144 -- so both trios over-run it into lbl_8011DDEC, a 36-byte object that is exactly three s32[3] colour trios and matches OPTMENU's rgb_off/rgb_on/rgb_hi pointer trio. Respelling them against lbl_8011DDEC is precisely the move the new law forbids: show_optmenu's target carries ONE @lbl_8011DD20 HA/LO pair and reaches +216/+228 by immediate add, so naming the interior symbol would emit a second relocation pair and regress exactly as the shop.c A/B did. Left raw on purpose. Also still raw and blocked on the header, for the next owner of include/game/player.h: p+7644/7648/7660 in the pad_1CD4 run.
